name: gmail_archive_messages
description: Archive explicit Gmail messages by removing INBOX.

name: gmail_create_draft
description: Create a Gmail draft from literal text or HTML; no local files are read.

bcc.description: Comma-separated Bcc recipients; omitted Bcc is cleared on update

body.description: Literal plain text body; body or body_html is required

body_html.description: Literal HTML body; body or body_html is required

cc.description: Comma-separated Cc recipients; omitted Cc is cleared on update

quote.description: Include the original message in the reply body

reply_all.description: Resolve recipients from the reply target

reply_to_message_id.description: Reply target Gmail message ID; mutually exclusive with thread_id

thread_id.description: Reply target Gmail thread ID; mutually exclusive with reply_to_message_id

to.description: Comma-separated recipients; optional for a draft. On update, omit to keep To or pass an empty string to clear it.

name: gmail_get_draft
description: Read one Gmail draft, including its MIME payload, without downloading attachments.

name: gmail_get_message
description: Get one Gmail message by ID. Sanitized content is enabled by default.

sanitize_content.description: Strip URLs/HTML and omit raw payloads

name: gmail_get_thread
description: Get one Gmail thread by ID. Sanitized content is enabled by default.

sanitize_content.description: Strip URLs/HTML and omit raw payloads

name: gmail_list_drafts
description: List Gmail draft IDs and their message/thread IDs, one bounded page at a time.

page.description: Page token returned by a previous call

name: gmail_list_labels
description: List Gmail labels and their case-sensitive IDs.

name: gmail_mark_read
description: Mark explicit Gmail messages as read.

name: gmail_mark_unread
description: Mark explicit Gmail messages as unread.

name: gmail_modify_messages
description: Add or remove labels on explicit Gmail messages. Label IDs are case-sensitive; names use CLI label lookup.

add_labels.description: Literal label names or case-sensitive IDs; commas and backslashes in each entry are preserved

remove_labels.description: Literal label names or case-sensitive IDs; commas and backslashes in each entry are preserved

name: gmail_modify_thread
description: Add or remove labels on every message in one Gmail thread. Label IDs are case-sensitive.

add_labels.description: Literal label names or case-sensitive IDs; commas and backslashes in each entry are preserved

remove_labels.description: Literal label names or case-sensitive IDs; commas and backslashes in each entry are preserved

name: gmail_restore_messages
description: Remove TRASH from explicit Gmail messages. Does not add INBOX.

name: gmail_search
description: Search Gmail messages with Gmail query syntax. Returns message summaries; message bodies are optional (include_body). Set headers for other header values such as List-Id or Sender. Set sanitize_content to get sanitized body and header text.

headers.description: Header names, e.g. List-Id and Sender. Each result gets a headers object keyed by canonical name (list-id becomes List-Id, Message-ID becomes Message-Id); missing headers are empty and repeated ones give the first value

include_recipients.description: Include To, Cc, and Bcc headers

query.description: Gmail search query, e.g. newer_than:7d from:person@example.com

sanitize_content.description: Strip URLs/HTML from bodies and header text

name: gmail_trash_messages
description: Move explicit Gmail messages to Trash, removing INBOX.

name: gmail_update_draft
description: Replace a Gmail draft's subject/body. Omitted To, attachments, and reply lineage are preserved; omitted Cc/Bcc are cleared. Supply body_html to retain HTML.

bcc.description: Comma-separated Bcc recipients; omitted Bcc is cleared on update

body.description: Literal plain text body; body or body_html is required

body_html.description: Literal HTML body; body or body_html is required

cc.description: Comma-separated Cc recipients; omitted Cc is cleared on update

clear_reply_context.description: Remove existing reply headers; incompatible with reply targets and quote

quote.description: Include the original message in the reply body

reply_all.description: Resolve recipients from the reply target

reply_to_message_id.description: Reply target Gmail message ID; mutually exclusive with thread_id

thread_id.description: Reply target Gmail thread ID; mutually exclusive with reply_to_message_id

to.description: Comma-separated recipients; optional for a draft. On update, omit to keep To or pass an empty string to clear it.
